name: Zombie Sniper: Apocalypse Survival
summary: Zombie Sniper: Apocalypse Survival puts you in an immersive VR zombie shooter built around unique, story-driven rescue missions. Take the high ground as an elite sniper, defend civilians, doctors, students & evacuation teams, protect vehicles, clear infected city streets, & survive relentless zombie waves. Master precision shooting, eliminate fixed targets, unlock powerful sniper rifles, prioritize dangerous infected, & fight through a cinematic zombie apocalypse where every shot matters
